items.evidence: ابن كثير / الم تر الذين كفروا / بغير واو بعد الهمزة والباقون بالواو
items.anchor_at_hint: At-Taysir explicitly gives الم تر الذين كفروا without a waw after the hamza in its Anbiya sequence; this is the 21:30 reading item u193329-1.

items.evidence: نافع {مثقال حبة} هنا وفي لقمان برفع اللام والباقون بنصبها

items.note: Abū Bakr is represented as Shuʿba under the book-specific authority mapping. The reader names Ibn ʿĀmir and Abū Bakr occur immediately before the next slash-delimited lemma نجى المؤمنين and are assigned there under the sequential convention.

Because the reader of the tāʾ form is not identified, the scope of the remainder for the yāʾ form cannot be resolved without inferring the omitted group. Its wording is preserved here without expanding a reader set.
